decision.title: Decision made
decision.refundLine: {amount} is refunded to you, on your card within 5 to 10 days.
decision.payoutLine: {amount} is on its way to your account, in your bank within 2 to 7 days.
decision.noPayoutLine: No payout is owed to you on this deal.
decision.final: This decision is final in the app.
decision.recourse: Disagree? Request conventional mediation by email.

SHIPPER.REJECTED: Your report was not upheld: the traveler is paid in full.
SHIPPER.PARTIAL_REFUND: Your report is partly upheld: partial refund.
SHIPPER.FULL_REFUND: Your report is upheld: full refund.
SHIPPER.COMPENSATE_CARRIER: The cancellation retention goes to the traveler.
SHIPPER.RESTITUTE_SHIPPER: The cancellation retention comes back to you.

CARRIER.REJECTED: The report was not upheld: you are paid in full.
CARRIER.PARTIAL_REFUND: The report is partly upheld: part of the price is refunded to the shipper.
CARRIER.FULL_REFUND: The report is upheld: the shipper is refunded in full.
CARRIER.COMPENSATE_CARRIER: The cancellation retention comes to you.
CARRIER.RESTITUTE_SHIPPER: The cancellation retention goes back to the shipper.

statement.title: Give your side
statement.intro: Explain what happened, with your photos (pickup, hand-over). Once only, until {deadline}. We decide after reading both sides.
statement.placeholder: E.g. I picked up the parcel closed in front of the shipper, full checklist, and handed it to the recipient who validated the code…
statement.once: Your statement can't be edited once sent.
statement.sentText: Sent on {date}. We decide within 5 business days: you'll be notified here and by email.
statement.closedText: The time to give your side has passed. The decision is in progress: you'll be notified here and by email.
statement.toastConflict: This case no longer accepts a statement (already sent or decided).
